title: This Week In AI Chips - Palomino's Strategic Acquisition Boosts AI Interconnect Market Expansion
title_zh: 本周AI芯片——Palomino战略收购助推AI互连市场扩张
summary: Palomino Laboratories has completed its acquisition of Vega Links, positioning itself as a key player in the next-generation AI interconnect field.
summary_zh: Palomino Laboratories已完成对Vega Links的收购，将自己定位为下一代AI互联领域的关键参与者。

title: KKR to Buy Device Maker Integer in $5.7 Billion Deal
title_zh: KKR 将斥资 57 亿美元收购 Device Maker Integer
summary: (Bloomberg) -- KKR has agreed to buy US medical device company Integer Holdings Corp.
summary_zh: (彭博社) -- KKR 已同意收购美国医疗器械公司 Integer Holdings Corp.

title: IREN (NasdaqGS:IREN) Lands Microsoft And Nvidia AI Cloud Deals Covering Most Revenue Target
title_zh: IREN (NasdaqGS:IREN) 与微软和 Nvidia 的人工智能云交易涵盖了大部分收入目标
summary: IREN (NasdaqGS:IREN) has expanded its AI Cloud business with new multi-year contracts from major technology companies. These contracts include agreements with Microsoft and NVIDIA and cover a large share of IREN's targeted year-end revenue.
summary_zh: IREN（纳斯达克股票代码：IREN）通过与主要科技公司签订的新的多年期合同扩展了其人工智能云业务。这些合同包括与微软和 NVIDIA 的协议，涵盖了 IREN 年终目标收入的很大一部分。

title: IonQ closes $1.8bn SkyWater acquisition after US FTC clearance
title_zh: 美国 FTC 批准后，IonQ 完成 18 亿美元收购 SkyWater
summary: SkyWater will continue serving aerospace, defence, and commercial markets while adding IonQ’s quantum technologies.
summary_zh: SkyWater 将继续服务航空航天、国防和商业市场，同时添加 IonQ 的量子技术。

title: Salesforce (CRM) Stock May Be 49% Undervalued On Its $1.6B VA Deal
title_zh: Salesforce (CRM) 股票因其 1.6B 美元 VA 交易可能被低估 49%
summary: Salesforce stock has rebounded in recent weeks after a challenging start to the year, and valuation tools now suggest the market price may sit well below an intrinsic value estimate based on a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model.
summary_zh: 在经历了今年充满挑战的开局后，Salesforce 股票最近几周出现反弹，估值工具现在表明，市场价格可能远低于基于贴现现金流 (DCF) 模型的内在价值估计。
